service_boundary: Represents model inference and deployments in watsonx.ai Runtime, not watsonx Assistant, watsonx.data, individual Granite releases, or models hosted outside IBM Cloud.
regional_controls: IBM Cloud service instances, supported models, and deployment spaces are region-specific; availability depends on the selected IBM Cloud location.
retention_controls: Data handling follows IBM Cloud terms, account controls, and the selected foundation-model or deployment feature; stored assets and stateless calls have distinct boundaries.
routing: Customers select foundation models or deployed assets in IBM Cloud rather than automatic upstream-provider routing.
customization: Prompt tuning, fine-tuning, custom foundation models, and deployment spaces are available for supported workflows.
strengths: IBM Granite and third-party models integrate with IBM Cloud governance and deployment spaces.
The service covers hosted APIs and customer deployment workflows.
tradeoffs: Availability and feature support vary by region and cloud plan.
The API surface spans several watsonx resource types rather than one universal endpoint.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: IBM watsonx.ai foundation-model API documentation, for IBM watsonx.ai Runtime

upstream_disclosure.note: The foundation-model security page for watsonx.ai on IBM Cloud states: "The foundation models are hosted in IBM Cloud or AWS; your prompts are not sent to third-party platforms." and "IBM does not use your work to improve IBM models."
upstream_disclosure.scope: IBM watsonx.ai foundation-model security page, for IBM watsonx.ai Runtime

credential_handling.note: The service offers no customer-supplied-key path: "Use your API key to generate an IAM bearer token." and every documented request uses IBM Cloud credentials.
credential_handling.scope: IBM watsonx.ai credentials for programmatic access, for IBM watsonx.ai Runtime

cache_isolation.note: No prompt or prefix caching scope is documented in the foundation-model API documentation.
cache_isolation.scope: IBM watsonx.ai foundation-model API documentation, for IBM watsonx.ai Runtime

vulnerability_disclosure.note: IBM publishes a company-wide security.txt naming its product security incident response team ("Contact: https://www.ibm.com/trust/security-psirt", "Contact: mailto:psirt@us.ibm.com").
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: IBM security.txt, for IBM watsonx.ai Runtime

independent_audit.note: The IBM Cloud SOC 2 page lists the platform services in scope and does not name watsonx.ai, so it is recorded as undocumented for the named service.
independent_audit.scope: IBM Cloud SOC 2 compliance page, read for IBM watsonx.ai Runtime
